name: Светлый ясень
style: PALE ASH / INK: light desaturated ash boards, nearly flat faces, fine quiet grain, thin dark ink-like rim and clipped corners. Tab lettering dark charcoal. Narrow pale timber panel rails, simple clean parchment cards. Active marker a small dull red wooden pin. Primary button dark terracotta-stained wood. Airy, restrained illustrated expedition journal; minimal border thickness.
prompt: Create ONE complete fully illustrated 16:9 hub screen for intoDeDung. Use the reference for layout, fortress, labels and exactly three squad cards. Keep four top tabs, resource line, squad left, open fortress courtyard center, preparation right and main button bottom-right. Stone fortress, tents, plain red/blue flags, warm sunset; exactly three small courtyard heroes. Focus on BUTTONS AND FRAMES: every tab and action has visible MATTE WOOD as its entire face, subdued grain and diffuse shading. No lacquer, gloss, shiny metal, gold edges, glow, jewels or specular streaks. Warm cream labels on dark wood, dark ink on pale wood. Selected tab and selected hero use a quiet painted brick/ochre line plus a small marker; absolutely no bright yellow/gold card outline. Primary CTA is more prominent through silhouette and muted red-brown wood, not shine. Panel interiors calm parchment. Information rows must stay flat text, not raised buttons. Do not duplicate cards or add UI. Exact labels: 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', 'Дополнительно'; 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', 'В путь'; 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'. Simple readable icons. Full finished screen, no collage, no outside captions, no watermark. VARIANT: PALE ASH / INK: light desaturated ash boards, nearly flat faces, fine quiet grain, thin dark ink-like rim and clipped corners. Tab lettering dark charcoal. Narrow pale timber panel rails, simple clean parchment cards. Active marker a small dull red wooden pin. Primary button dark terracotta-stained wood. Airy, restrained illustrated expedition journal; minimal border thickness.
